items.label: SPY
items.why: The boot: loads S0 at $2800 and runs it, then loads S1 and S2 with the KERNAL and jumps to S1's restart routine at $081B

items.label: S0
items.why: The credits screen and the loading picture, with the code that shows them while the KERNAL loads S1 and S2; none of it stays in memory once the game runs (graphics.html, the credits and the loading picture)

items.label: S1
items.why: The game, packed: a machine frozen with Trilogic's Expert cartridge, whose restart routine at $081B unpacks memory and resumes at $0A03

items.label: S2
items.why: The last page of S1's packed stream, loaded at $CC00 by SPY; S1's restart routine reads it up to $CCF0 when it moves the packed data to the top of memory ($0839)
